description:
Looking to join a world-class blockchain development team? Ava Labs makes it simple to deploy high-performance solutions for Web3, led by innovations on Avalanche. The company was founded by Cornell computer scientists, who partnered with Wall Street veterans and early Web3 leaders to execute a promising vision for redefining the way people build permissionless networks. Ava Labs is redefining the way people create value with Web3. Join us as we empower people to easily and freely digitize all the world’s assets on one open, programmable blockchain platform.

About the Role

As a Principal DevSecOps Engineer, you will build AI agents and automations that handle cloud and Kubernetes security work, including asset discovery, configuration and posture assessment, policy enforcement, and remediation. You will treat agent development as a core part of the role rather than a side project. You will also be our expert and principal advisor on cloud and Kubernetes security: inventorying our infrastructure, assessing its current state, and leading the roadmap that hardens it. You will implement those changes in a methodical, well-documented way, with agents handling the repeatable work and humans reviewing the decisions that matter. You will also embed security into how our engineering teams build and operate, shipping agents and guardrails that make the secure path the easy path.

Level: Principal
Team: Information Security
Reports to: Chief Information Security Officer
Location: Remote - Must have 4 hours cross-over with US time zones

What You'll Do

  • Build agents that maintain a complete, continuously updated inventory of everywhere we use Kubernetes and cloud instances, and report on the current state.

  • Lay out a roadmap for security optimization and implement the changes in a methodical, well-documented manner, with agents handling the repeatable work and humans reviewing the decisions that matter.

  • Build agents that discover and mitigate new security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in our cloud infrastructure.

  • Integrate security tools and associated processes into the DevOps team’s workflows, shipping agents and guardrails that make the secure path the easy path.

  • Implement cloud IAM access control policies according to industry best practices, using agents to detect drift and enforce least privilege.

  • Own the agents you build, including their evaluation, guardrails, access scoping, and auditability.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, using your technical capabilities and influence to design and support high performance and security across build projects and technical operations.

  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) in DevSecOps and security for CI/CD best practices, including automated, agent-driven checks in the pipeline.

What You'll Bring

  • Typically 15+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 12+ years with a Master’s, or 8+ years with a PhD, or equivalent experience.

  • Recognized expertise in DevSecOps and cloud security, serving as an expert and principal advisor who guides the development of new practices.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating AI agents (for example, using LLM APIs, tool use, and agent frameworks) to automate security and infrastructure workflows, including evaluation, guardrails, access scoping, and auditability.

  • Deep, hands-on experience securing Kubernetes and major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including cluster hardening, workload security, and cloud IAM.

  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and integrating security tooling (such as SAST/DAST, dependency and container image scanning, and secrets management) into DevOps workflows, including automated, agent-driven checks.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (such as Terraform) and policy as code, including building agents and automation that detect drift and enforce policy.

  • Proven ability to solve issues that affect program success and multiple functions, devising solutions from limited information and with a long-term view of strategic goals.

  • Strong judgment and wide latitude in setting objectives and approaches for critical assignments, including deciding which work agents can handle autonomously and which decisions require human review.

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and decision makers across engineering, building credibility internally and externally.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting current-state assessments, roadmaps, implementation work, and agent behavior for technical and executive audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with blockchain or distributed-systems infrastructure, including securing node and validator operations.

  • Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKS, or cloud-provider security specialty certifications.

  • Experience managing a team.

WHY AVA LABS?

Ava Labs builds Avalanche, the blockchain platform institutions use to bring finance onchain. Since Avalanche launched in 2020, we have helped exchanges, banks, asset managers and fintechs move from experiments to live products, from tokenized funds and private credit to stablecoin payments and, now, the clearing and settlement ledger for the NYSE’s upcoming tokenized securities platform. Avalanche lets institutions run their own purpose-built networks with the performance, costs and participation controls they need, while staying connected to a broad ecosystem of DeFi protocols, liquidity and developers.

We are a team of experts in engineering, finance, economics, product and law, headquartered in New York City. You will work alongside people who have built at leading banks, exchanges and crypto companies, with the scope to shape how capital markets move onchain over the next decade. Ava Labs is backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Polychain Capital and Initialized Capital.

Ava Labs is committed to diversity in the workplace and we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not hire on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
